notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-04-30) for the mergers of GPM and GGM into GOF under two separate merger agreements; neither merger is contingent on the other. Target holders receive Acquiring Fund common shares of equal aggregate NAV (cash for fractional shares). Each merger needs a 1940 Act Majority of the target's and of GOF's shareholders. termination_date: the form of Agreement and Plan of Merger (Exhibit B) states automatic termination if not consummated by June 30, 2021 'unless a later date is mutually agreed', which is before the stated meeting (2021-08-24) and expected close (fourth quarter of 2021); recorded as stated but likely a stale template date. Conditions are from Sections 8 and 9 of the form of agreement; 'other' covers the no-material-adverse-change certificate; the agreement also requires a final distribution of all income before closing (not mapped).
